newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in 2nd half July.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in 2nd half July.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose by $23.33 million in the second half of July to $6.574 billion, according to central bank figures published in newspapers on Saturday.
Gross reserves had risen by $20.82 million in the first half of July to $6.551 billion.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' net foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The bank's net reserves stood at $4.015 billion at the end of 1996 compared with $2.858 billion a year earlier. - Beirut editorial (9611) 745307 745308 602057
